title: The Sweep and the Noble Lady
logline: A pilgrim is hauled before the emir for praying that a lady quarrel with her husband; his story of how a filthy street sweep was scrubbed, feasted and rewarded for eight nights, and why, wins his release.
moral: Hear a man's story before you judge him; and good fortune that comes from another's quarrel ends when the quarrel does.
tone: Light comic irony with a wistful end: a rags-to-riches surprise told discreetly, the comedy carried by the smell gag, the donkey and the frame story at the Kaaba.

beats.summary: A man at the Kaaba prays a strange prayer: that a lady quarrel with her husband again.
Scandalised pilgrims seize him and carry him to the emir of the pilgrimage.
Facing punishment, he asks to tell his story; the emir listens (frame story opens).
Flashback: the filthy sweep with his donkey meets a rich lady's procession.
He hides, but the lady points him out and the guards take him to her palace.
He is sure he will be punished for his smell.
Instead he is bathed (behind a screen), dressed richly and sprinkled with rose water.
Fed dishes he cannot name, he believes he is dreaming.
After the night he is given fifty gold pieces; it repeats for eight nights and he cannot understand why.
On the eighth night the husband returns and the sweep must hide in the gallery.
The husband apologises at length and the lady forgives him.
Her secret: she had caught her husband betraying her with a maid.
Her revenge was to choose the dirtiest man in Baghdad: him.
The meetings are over; he is sent away.
Heartbroken, he goes on pilgrimage and prays for another quarrel: the opening explained.
The emir, having heard it all, lets him go.

sets.description: Kaaba court and the emir's canopy in one 1900 x 1230 world, ground y 900, day sky. Back: a white arcade of nine pointed arches (each 190 wide, y 520..900, blue dot shading inside). Kaaba: black box x 300..700, y 330..900 with a yellow band y 470..520 (plain dash pattern, no writing) and a yellow door 70 x 130 at x 560..630, y 730..860. Floor: paper with pale blue dots. Six faceless white background pilgrims at s 0.35 on a slow oval path behind the cube. Emir's canopy x 1250..1750: four poles, red and yellow striped awning y 430..520 with a scalloped edge, carpet dais x 1300..1700 top y 870, cushion at x 1600 (seat 48 high).

The planned marketStreet (7 other films) in a 2000-wide version, ground y 900: a wall of flat-roofed houses (roof lines y 380..520), butchers' yard door x 120..260 with a hanging bone sign, rubbish heap spot x 560, a dark alley recess x 300..440 (y 520..900, navy), and the palace gate x 1700..1950 (two doors, open 0..1, pointed arch top y 430, small window above at (1800, 430) that can show skyCycle or lamp light). Sky via skyCycle so the same set serves day (S4, S5, S10) and dusk (S15).

The planned palaceHall (AN-084: blue dotted back wall with three pointed arches, door arch on the left x 40..250 top y 480, dais x 560..900 top y 860, red runner, checker floor, two lamps) with three options added for this film: window (centre arch x 400..600, y 250..560 shows skyCycle(u)); decor 0..1 (garlands, extra hanging lamps, cushions and a low table x 520..760 top y 850); gallery (balcony floor y 470 from x 620 to 960 with a lattice screen y 330..470 and steps at x 900..980). Night tint from dayCycle(u).night.

actions.action: Freezes mid chew, looks at the hall, at her, at his own sleeve.
actions.acting: three held looks (gaze plan), suspicion brow +0.3

actions.action: Pinches his own cheek hard and yelps.
actions.acting: hand to cheek, then sq 0.92 jolt, eyes shut

actions.action: Opens his eyes: everything is still there. Slow stunned grin straight at the camera.
actions.acting: look to camera gaze [0, 0.05], held; one slow blink

scenes.summary: The night passes, shown discreetly: the camera goes to the arched window where dusk turns to night and then dawn, while below the two sit at the table talking and laughing. In the morning she gives him a purse of fifty gold pieces.

camera.notes: 81.3-82.6 tilt up to the centre arch window (x 500, y 420, zoom 1.3) with the two seated figures small at the bottom of frame. 85.4-86.0 tilt down and across to the door arch x 260, y 660, zoom 1.6 for the purse.

scenes.composition: Window in the centre arch x 400..600, y 250..560 showing skyCycle. Table and the two figures stay in frame bottom, seated 330 apart, lit by a lamp. Purse hand over at the door arch (x 150..250).

actions.action: Tilt up to the window: the sky turns from dusk to night, the moon rises on its arc and the stars fade in; the hall takes a night tint and the lamps glow.
actions.acting: slow and gentle; this is the whole picture of "the night"
actions.library: skyCycle(ctx, u) with u 0.45 to 0.75 via kfn; dayCycle(u).night for the tint

actions.action: At the table he tells the lady about his donkey, miming long ears with both hands.
actions.acting: animated, talk 0.7, big gestures
actions.library: aL/aR up beside the head; talk

actions.action: She laughs and answers with a story of her own, hands drawing in the air.
actions.acting: talk 0.6, gaze on him, he listens chin on hand
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.chin for the listener; eye contact both ways

actions.action: The moon crosses the window; a small moon icon lights at the top left of the panel with the tag NIGHT 1.
actions.acting: stars twinkle on seeds; lamp flames flicker

actions.action: Dawn: the window sky warms, the sun edge appears, the night tint lifts from the hall.
At the door she holds out a fat purse; it drops a little into his two cupped hands with its weight.
actions.acting: she gaze on the purse then on him; his hands sink 6 units and recover
actions.library: purse (planned prop); handRW both to the purse point; landSquash on the purse

actions.action: Loosens the string and peeks in; gold light shines up on his face.
actions.acting: eyes wide, pupils down into the purse, glow from below

actions.action: A counter above the purse ticks 0 to 50 with a coin icon.
actions.acting: counter eases, final 50 pops with overshoot

actions.action: Bites one coin to test it, grins, and bows his way backwards out of the door. When he is not looking, her smile fades to a thoughtful, distant face.
actions.acting: three quick bows (tip pulses); lady mask off: mouth closed, gaze away to the window, lid 0.4
actions.library: pulse() on tip; walk() backwards; lady gaze plan

scenes.summary: He is invited back the next day, and again for eight nights. Each morning he leaves with a gift, which piles up on the donkey. But he cannot understand why she cares for him.

camera.notes: Palace gate end of the street: x 1700, y 660, zoom 1.3. Eight moon icons sit along the top of the panel as the night counter. 102.3-105.0 slow push to zoom 1.7 on the puzzled sweep sitting on the step.

scenes.composition: Gate x 1700..1950 on the right; the donkey waits at x 1480; sweep acts between x 1560 and 1700. A small palace window above the gate (x 1800, y 430) shows the sky and lights the nights. Moon row at panel top, y 110 (panel space).

actions.action: Next day: he stands outside the palace gate in his fine robe, shifting from foot to foot.
actions.acting: gaze up at the window, hopeful; weight shifts

actions.action: A maid opens the gate a crack and beckons him.
actions.acting: small wave, quick look left and right

actions.action: She hands him a sealed invitation scroll; he reads it and hops for joy.
actions.acting: eyes scan two lines (saccades), then hop with landing squash

actions.action: The window above the gate starts cycling night, day, night; the first two moon icons light up in the row at the top.
actions.acting: each night = one quick sky flip
actions.library: skyCycle in the window; S.counter moons

actions.action: The moons fill one by one to eight (a tick about every 0.22 s from 96.2 to 97.8) and the tag reads 8 NIGHTS.
actions.acting: a 0.1 s dip before each tick, the eighth pops larger

actions.action: Morning: he walks out of the gate carrying a purse and sets it on the donkey's back.
actions.acting: jaunty walk, gaze on the gift; donkey ears perk

actions.action: Again: out of the gate with a folded cloth; again with a tray.
actions.acting: three quick passes, each shorter (0.35 s), sun pops over the wall each time

actions.action: The pile on the donkey grows to eight gifts; its knees sag a little more with each one.
actions.acting: kick on each drop, sq down to 0.94, ears splay

actions.action: The donkey turns its head to look at the tower on its back, then at the camera.
actions.acting: slow head turn, lid 0.5, deadpan

actions.action: Sits down on the gate step, chin in hand.
actions.acting: sit with settle, gaze up at the palace window, brow -0.5

actions.action: A thought cloud holds the lady's face and a large question mark.
actions.acting: cloud pops trail first; question mark rocks slightly

actions.action: He looks to the donkey for an answer; the donkey shrugs with its ears.
actions.acting: eye contact, donkey ears out sideways then back

actions.action: Sniffs his sleeve (roses now), shrugs with open palms to the camera.
actions.acting: palms up, brow -0.8, look to camera

scenes.summary: The eighth night. A knock at the door: a maid rushes in and orders him up to the gallery to hide behind the lattice. The lady's husband strides in with his soldiers.

camera.notes: 106.4-110.8 table two-shot x 600, y 700, zoom 1.4. 110.9-113.6 crane up with him to the gallery (x 760, y 470, zoom 1.3). 114.4 pull out to the full hall x 500, y 600, zoom 1.02: gallery top right, door arch bottom left.

scenes.composition: Gallery (new palaceHall option): balcony floor y 470 from x 620 to 960, lattice screen y 330..470, stairs at the right edge x 900..980. Door arch at the left x 40..250. The hiding place and the door are on opposite corners so one wide shot holds both.

actions.action: The card clears on the night hall: lamps lit, the two at the table as before, the eight moons lit at the top.
actions.acting: relaxed: he is mid story, she smiles
actions.library: S.transition later (camera cut hidden at the card midpoint)

actions.action: The door shakes with three knocks (sound arcs at the door). Both heads snap to it, his first, hers a beat later; she stands.
actions.acting: eyes wide; lady sit 1 to 0 with composure
actions.library: soundArcs at the door; stagger(); kick on the door

actions.action: A maid runs in from the side, skids to a stop and points up at the gallery.
actions.acting: lurch on the stop, eyes wide, arm straight up

actions.action: Flaps both hands at him: go, go!
actions.acting: talk 0.8, urgent brow -0.7

actions.action: Springs up from the cushion, spins left and right looking for a way out, then runs for the stairs.
actions.acting: anticipate + hop, saccades, legs fast but not sliding

actions.action: Climbs the steps to the gallery two at a time; the camera cranes up with him.
actions.acting: hops per step with small squashes

actions.action: Ducks behind the lattice screen. Label HIDE! with an arrow; then only his two eyes show in a lattice gap.
actions.acting: eyes peek, blink, sink
actions.library: S.arrow, S.label; eyes drawn behind the lattice (actor then occluder)

actions.action: Below, the lady smooths her veil and sits down with her back half turned to the door; the maid whisks his cushion away.
actions.acting: mask on: chin up, lid 0.4, arms folded

actions.action: The door swings open and the husband strides in: big turban, cape trailing, chest out, then slowing as he sees her turned back.
actions.acting: walk with cape lag; his stride shortens, hands open at his sides

actions.action: Two soldiers take posts either side of the door and thump their spears, one a beat after the other. Up in the lattice the eyes sink lower and tremble.
actions.acting: guards rigid, eyes front; hidden eyes tremble 1 unit

scenes.summary: From the gallery he watches the husband apologise at great length (a candle burns down) until the lady forgives him. When the husband has gone she calls the sweep down to tell him her secret.

camera.notes: 118.2-124.3 full hall x 500, y 600, zoom 1.02 with a short over the lattice insert at 118.2-119.5 (x 760, y 500, zoom 1.5 looking down). 125.9 ease to a two-shot on the hall floor x 560, y 680, zoom 1.5; 128.2-130.8 push to zoom 1.9 on the lady.

scenes.composition: Husband kneels at x 360, lady sits at x 640 on the dais, candle on the table at x 560. Watching eyes in the lattice at (790, 400). After the exit: lady x 640, sweep stops at x 380 (a respectful gap).

actions.action: Insert from the gallery: the two eyes in the lattice gap look down at the scene below.
actions.acting: gaze [-0.6, 0.7], a slow blink
actions.library: CAM insert; eye2 behind the lattice

actions.action: Goes down on both knees, hands clasped, head bowed. She does not turn.
actions.acting: kneel 0 to 1 with settle; lady nose up, gaze away, lid 0.5

actions.action: It goes on and on: the candle on the table burns down in three steps (120.5, 121.0, 121.5) while he offers a gift box, then flowers, then bows his turban to the floor. A small tag counts SORRY x1, x2, x3.
actions.acting: each offer bigger than the last; she peeks sideways once (the peek) and looks away again; the eyes upstairs follow each offer like a tennis match
actions.library: candle {burn: 0..1} drawn in the scene; PERSON_HANDS.reach; S.counter

actions.action: Her shoulders drop; she turns to him, the frown melts into a small smile and she holds out her hand.
actions.acting: brow +0.6 to 0, lid 0.5 to 0.15; turn with a squeeze, veil late

actions.action: Takes her hand with both of his and rises, breathing out; a small heart pops between them. Upstairs the watching eyes turn wet and the brows droop.
actions.acting: husband sq 1.04 to 1 (relief); sweep wet: true, lid 0.4
actions.library: handRW to her hand; heart(); kneel 1 to 0

actions.action: He bows and leaves through the door arch; the soldiers file out after him one by one; the door closes. Only then does her smile fade.
actions.acting: staggered exits; lady mask off after the door shuts: mouth closed, gaze down

actions.action: Looks up at the gallery and beckons. His head rises above the lattice and he comes slowly down the stairs.
actions.acting: her gaze up right; he walks with head low, turban slightly askew

actions.action: Stops a few paces from her, hands clasped in front; she gestures to a cushion but he stays standing.
actions.acting: gaze on the floor then up to her, brow -0.5

actions.action: Raises one finger, then lays it across her lips: a secret. Push in on her face.
actions.acting: lid lowers, gaze slides away, then back to him: steely

actions.action: Three trail bubbles rise from her head toward the top of the frame, announcing her story.
actions.acting: bubbles pop in order; he watches them rise (gaze follows)

scenes.summary: Her secret, told in one large thought cloud with small pictogram figures: she found her husband giving a rose to a maid (the heart cracks); in fury she swore to answer it with the dirtiest man in Baghdad, and the search ring lands on the ragged sweep.

camera.notes: x 500, y 560, zoom 1.1: lady bottom right (x 700), sweep bottom left (x 300), the cloud filling the top half; a slow 20 unit drift toward the cloud. 137.4-140.6 brief push to the lady (zoom 1.5) for the vow, then back.

scenes.composition: Cloud at (500, 330), 620 x 380, scale 0.5; cloud figures about 120 px tall. The two real heads stay below y 600 and are never covered by the cloud.

actions.action: The large cloud pops open above them. She speaks; he listens.
actions.acting: lady talk 0.6, gaze into the distance; sweep gaze on her

actions.action: In the cloud: a tiny lady pushes a door open and stops in the doorway.
actions.acting: door swings 0.4 s; her eyes go wide
actions.library: kfn door; person costume lady at cloud scale

actions.action: In the cloud: the husband is holding out a rose to a maid; a small heart floats above the two. (Discreet picture of the betrayal: a rose and a heart, nothing more.)
actions.acting: tiny husband smile, maid lid lowered; tiny lady hands fly to her head

actions.action: The heart in the cloud cracks down the middle and the halves fall. The tiny maid hides her face and runs out; the husband turns, mouth open.
actions.acting: zigzag split, halves fall with gravity and a small bounce

actions.action: In the real hall the maid, crossing the background with a tray, freezes at the word and tiptoes out backwards.
actions.acting: eyes to camera, then careful back steps

actions.action: The cloud floods red. The real lady raises a fist; an angry flush climbs her face.
actions.acting: brow +1, anticipation dip then fist up with overshoot
actions.library: flush (planned effect); anticipate(), settleTo(); cloud bg red

actions.action: She stamps her foot: the dishes on the table hop and two steam puffs leave her veil. The sweep leans back.
actions.acting: stamp with squash; sweep tip -0.08, eyes wide

actions.action: In the cloud a red zigzag bolt knocks the tiny husband's turban askew.
actions.acting: comic, bloodless; turban spins a quarter turn and settles crooked
actions.library: kfn bolt; swing() on the turban

actions.action: The cloud changes to a row of Baghdad rooftops with a search ring gliding along it.
actions.acting: ring eases house to house
actions.library: nightCity style skyline in day colours inside the cloud; ring = stroked circle

actions.action: The ring passes a neat merchant (red X), then a tidy servant (red X).
actions.acting: each X stamps with a 2 frame overshoot; rejected figures shrug

actions.action: The ring lands on the ragged sweep with his donkey, smell lines and flies. A tag FILTHIEST! pops with an arrow. The real sweep looks from the cloud to himself and points at his own chest.
actions.acting: ring bounces twice on him; real sweep mouth o, brow -0.8
actions.library: stinkLines at cloud scale; S.label, S.arrow; PERSON_HANDS.chest

scenes.summary: She chose him for exactly that reason, and now that her husband is back the meetings are over. The eight moons go out. He deflates.

camera.notes: twoShot(sweep, lady, {margin: 140}) x 500, y 660, zoom 1.4; 147.6-149.2 push to zoom 1.9 on the sweep; back to the two-shot at 149.3; 155.6 ease wide (zoom 1.1) as she walks away.

scenes.composition: Lady at x 700 facing left, sweep at x 300 facing right. Moon row at the top of the panel. Door arch on the left behind him, held open by the maid from 153.7.

actions.action: Points at him with the very same straight arm as in the street (setup and payoff).
actions.acting: same pose values as 47.3; calm face, no cruelty

actions.action: An arrow runs from the ragged figure in the cloud to the real, clean sweep.
actions.acting: arrow draws on in 0.4 s

actions.action: The cloud pops. He deflates: shoulders down, gaze to the floor, turban slipping; one pale ghost of a smell line rises from him and fades.
actions.acting: sq 1 to 0.93, lid 0.5, mouth frown; turban lags the head drop by 3 frames

actions.action: She softens: lowers the arm, speaks gently with open palms.
actions.acting: brow -0.2, talk 0.5, head tilt

actions.action: The row of eight lit moons reappears at the top of the panel.
actions.acting: quick stagger on, right to left

actions.action: The moons go dark one by one (eight pops in 0.8 s). He watches each one go.
actions.acting: his pupils step along the row (saccades)

actions.action: The maid opens the door arch behind him and waits, eyes down.
actions.acting: quiet, no gesture

actions.action: She glances at the door her husband left by and lays a hand on her heart.
actions.acting: gaze to the door then down, lid 0.4

actions.action: She turns away toward the dais, veil following late. He reaches a hand after her, then lets it fall.
actions.acting: his reach holds 0.4 s, then the arm drops with a settle; wet eyes

scenes.summary: Outside the closed gate at dusk he grieves; then he and the donkey set off, the street giving way to dunes and at last to the Kaaba court, where he raises his hands in the very pose of the opening and prays for one more quarrel.

camera.notes: 157.0-160.6 x 1640, y 660, zoom 1.6 at the gate. 160.7-162.3 track right with the walk while the background slides (street, dunes, court). 162.4 lands on the exact S1 framing (x 640, y 640, zoom 1.45 in kaabaCourt coordinates).

scenes.composition: Sweep at x 1600, donkey at x 1480, small lit window above the gate at (1800, 430). For the journey he walks in place at screen centre while three background plates slide past; a foreground palm trunk crossing the frame at 161.9 hides the change of costume and set.

actions.action: The gate shuts behind him. He stands with his head sinking, eyes wet; one tear, one long blink.
actions.acting: slow head drop 8 px, wet: true, lid 0.6 then a 0.4 s blink; dusk sky

actions.action: The donkey nuzzles his arm, ears drooping; he pats it without looking.
actions.acting: donkey head turn, earL/earR -0.6; his hand finds the muzzle

actions.action: Looks back up at the lit window: a silhouette draws the curtain and the light goes out. A small heart above him cracks and the halves slide apart.
actions.acting: gaze up right, a breath (sq 1.03 then 0.97), shoulders drop

actions.action: He takes the rope and walks; the street slides away behind him into dunes with a low sun, then the white arcade of the court. A palm trunk wipes across the frame.
actions.acting: steady walk, head slowly lifting; legs never slide (phase from background distance)
actions.library: walk() driven by the plate offset; footfalls dust; foreground occluder for the hidden cut

actions.action: After the palm he is in the white pilgrim robe in the Kaaba court, in the same place and framing as at 4.4 s.
actions.acting: match the S1 pose exactly (same P object)
actions.library: bake(kaabaCourt); CAM key equal to S1

actions.action: Dips and raises both hands, palms up: the opening pose, now understood.
actions.acting: identical timing to 3.6-4.6; gaze up, lid 0.2
actions.library: reuse the S1 pose function with a time offset

actions.action: The same thought cloud as the opening: lady and husband back to back with the red bolt.
actions.acting: same drawing as S1 (reuse the inside function); the bolt flickers twice

actions.action: Opens one eye toward heaven with a hopeful grin.
actions.acting: wink 'R', smile, tiny sway

scenes.summary: Back under the canopy: everyone has been listening like children. The emir tries to keep a straight face, fails, laughs and waves the man free. Freed, he turns toward the Kaaba and raises his hands again. THE END.

camera.notes: x 1480, y 660, zoom 1.35 on the group; 170.2-171.9 ease out to zoom 1.1 as he rises; hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Emir at x 1600 (seated), sweep kneeling at x 1380, the three pilgrims sitting on the carpet at x 1150, 1220, 1290, guard standing behind the emir at x 1700. THE END title in the upper third, clear of all heads.

actions.action: Whip back to the canopy. The three pilgrims now sit cross legged on the carpet, mouths open; the guard leans on his spear; the emir is bent far forward, chin on his fist.
actions.acting: everyone holds still for 0.6 s: only blinks

actions.action: The emir's shoulders begin to shake and his moustache twitches; he presses his lips shut.
actions.acting: tremble 2 units, lid 0.5, mouth closed tight (stifled laugh)

actions.action: He bursts out laughing, head thrown back; the pilgrims look at each other and crack up one after another, the oldest hiding it behind his hand.
actions.acting: emir tip -0.1, mouth open, eyes shut; pilgrims stagger 5 frames; sweep looks around, bewildered and hopeful

actions.action: Wipes an eye and waves a hand: go, go. The guard steps back from the sweep.
actions.acting: loose wave, still chuckling (sq pulses)

actions.action: Springs to his feet, bows low twice and backs away to the left.
actions.acting: anticipate, hop, landSquash; two tip pulses; big smile

actions.action: After the last word he turns toward the distant Kaaba and raises his hands to pray again.
actions.acting: same prayer pose; one eye peeks back at the emir

actions.action: The three pilgrims clap their hands to their heads, one after another; the emir laughs again.
actions.acting: stagger 4 frames

actions.action: THE END title pops and holds to 175.1; lamps and background pilgrims keep a slow drift.
actions.acting: title overshoot and settle; nothing covers a face

ending.description: After the last word (171.96) the freed sweep turns toward the Kaaba and raises his hands again; the pilgrims clap their heads and the emir laughs. THE END pops at 173.1 in the upper third and holds to 175.1 with slow background drift and blinks.

subtitles.ar: في موسم الحج وقف رجل عند الكعبة يدعو دعاءً غريبًا:|أن تغضب امرأة من زوجها مرة أخرى فيعود إليها.|سمعه بعض الحجاج، فغضبوا وأمسكوا به،|ثم حملوه إلى أمير الحج يطلبون عقابه.
subtitles.en: During the pilgrimage, a man at the Kaaba prayed|that a woman would quarrel with her husband again.|Pilgrims were scandalized|and brought him before their emir.

subtitles.ar: أمر الأمير بعقابه،|فطلب الرجل أن يسمع قصته.|قال إنه كان يجمع مخلفات المسالخ على حمار،|حين رأى موكب سيدة غنية وحراسها.
subtitles.en: The emir ordered his punishment,|but the man asked to tell his story.|He used to collect slaughterhouse refuse on a donkey|when he saw a wealthy lady's procession and guards.

subtitles.ar: اختبأ الكناس في زقاق ليمر الموكب،|لكن السيدة أشارت إليه،|فأمسكه الحراس وساقوه إلى قصرها.|ظن أنها ستعاقبه بسبب رائحة عمله.
subtitles.en: The sweeper hid in an alley to let the procession pass,|but the lady pointed him out.|Guards took him to her palace,|where he feared punishment for the smell of his work.

subtitles.ar: بدل العقاب أدخلوه الحمام،|وغسلوه وألبسوه ثيابًا فاخرة ورشوا عليه ماء الورد.|ثم قدّمته السيدة إلى مجلس مزين،|وأطعمته أطعمة لم يعرف أسماءها، فحسب أنه يحلم من شدة الدهشة.
subtitles.en: Instead, servants bathed him,|dressed him richly,|and led him into a splendid hall.|The lady fed him delicacies, leaving him convinced he was dreaming.

subtitles.ar: أمضى الكناس معها ليلة، ثم أعطته صرة فيها خمسون قطعة ذهبية.|عاد في اليوم التالي بدعوة منها، وتكرر اللقاء ثماني ليال،|وكان يعود كل صباح ومعه هدية.|لكنه لم يفهم سبب اهتمامها المفاجئ به.
subtitles.en: He spent the night with her and received fifty gold pieces.|She summoned him repeatedly for eight nights,|rewarding him each morning,|without explaining why.

subtitles.ar: في الليلة الثامنة أمرته خادمة بالاختباء في غرفة مرتفعة،|إذ عاد زوج السيدة مع جنوده.|رأى الرجل الزوج يعتذر طويلًا حتى رضيت عنه زوجته.|وبعد رحيله كشفت السيدة للكناس السر الذي أخفته عنه.
subtitles.en: On the eighth night he hid|as the lady’s husband returned.|The husband begged forgiveness, and she reconciled with him.|Afterwards, she explained her secret.

subtitles.ar: قالت إنها اكتشفت زوجها يخونها مع إحدى الخادمات،|فأقسمت غاضبة أن تنتقم بعلاقة مع أكثر رجال بغداد اتساخًا.|اختارته لهذا السبب بالذات،|وأخبرته أن لقاءاتهما ستنتهي ما دام زوجها قد عاد إليها.
subtitles.en: She had caught her husband with a servant|and, in anger, vowed revenge by seeking the filthiest man in Baghdad.|She chose the sweeper|and now ended their affair.

subtitles.ar: حزن الكناس لفراقها،|وذهب للحج يدعو أن يتكرر خلافها مع زوجها.|فلما سمع الأمير حكايته أطلق سراحه.
subtitles.en: Sad at losing her,|the sweeper went on pilgrimage and prayed that she would quarrel with her husband again.|After hearing his story, the emir released him.

new_assets.name: kaabaCourt
new_assets.description: Kaaba court with arcade, background pilgrims and a side canopy for the emir (dimensions under sets). Reusable for any pilgrimage scene; the canopy alone (drawn by a separate function pavilion(ctx, x, y, {w, stripes})) serves any judge, emir or market awning.
new_assets.implementation: One bake() layer: sky(), arcade as nine roundRect/arc paths with dots(), the Kaaba as a black rect with a yellow band (dashes by a seeded loop) and door; background pilgrims drawn live as two-shape figures (circle head, tapered white robe) on an ellipse path with seeded phase. pavilion: four pole rects, striped polygon awning with a scalloped lower edge (arcs), carpet rect with trim.

new_assets.name: palaceHall
new_assets.description: The planned arched hall plus window (skyCycle), decor and gallery options (see sets).
new_assets.implementation: Follow the AN-084 plan for the base. window: clip the centre arch and call skyCycle(ctx, u, {w: 200}) inside. gallery: floor slab rect, lattice as a clipped grid of diagonal lines with 3 open diamond gaps, steps as 5 stacked rects. decor: garlands as sagging arcs with dots, lamps as swing() pendulums.

new_assets.name: marketStreet
new_assets.description: Planned market street, 2000-wide variant with alley recess, yard door and palace gate (see sets).
new_assets.implementation: Reuse the planned marketStreet function; add options {alley: [x0, x1], gate: {x, open}, sign}. The alley is a navy rect drawn before the actors, with a wall strip drawn after them as the occluder for peeks.

new_assets.name: donkey
new_assets.description: Planned donkey (AN-001, AN-084); this film adds wicker panniers and a gift stack on its back, drawn by the scene at the P.back point.
new_assets.implementation: As planned: quadruped built like the Library deer (walk via walk()), long ears with earL/earR, headTurn, sit. Panniers: two trapezoids with weave lines either side of the back.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (sweep, pilgrim, guard)
new_assets.description: Three presets on the Library costume layer: 'sweep' (ragged short tunic with two patches, frayed cap, bare feet, smudge: 0..3 soot marks on the face), 'pilgrim' (plain white robe, bare head, bare feet, beard by age), and the planned 'guard' (AN-086). 'emir' is an alias of vizier with a green palette.
new_assets.implementation: Add rows to the COSTUME table in cast/people.js; smudges are 3 seeded dark ellipses with alpha 0.5 drawn after the face; shoes: 'bare' already exists.

new_assets.name: palanquin
new_assets.description: Carried litter for ladies, kings and brides (see props).
new_assets.implementation: roundRect body, half-ellipse dome, two pole rects, curtains as two polygons that swing() after each bearer footfall; the rider is a person drawn first and clipped to the window rect. Position = mean of the two bearers, bob from their walk().

new_assets.name: bathScreen
new_assets.description: Folding screen that hides a bath or a change of clothes (see props); the discreet way to stage any washing or dressing.
new_assets.implementation: Three rects whose widths scale with fold (hinge by scaling x about each panel edge); steam = cloudFlat puffs rising with alpha; foam cap = cluster of white circles on the head; bubbles = K.rng circles drifting up.

new_assets.name: stinkLines
new_assets.description: Smell lines with flies, with a rose option (see props). Running gag of the film; reusable for rubbish, old fish, perfume (rose mode).
new_assets.implementation: Three sine-wave strokes (amplitude 10, wavelength 50) translated upward with t and faded at the top; flies = 4 px black ellipses with two white wing dots on Lissajous orbits from K.noise; rose: mix the colour to pink with mixHex and end the top line in a spiral plus five petals.

new_assets.name: rosewaterSprinkler + banquet dishes + candle
new_assets.description: Small flat props: long-necked flask with drops, three dishes (pastry dome, sweet pyramid, jelly), candle with burn 0..1.
new_assets.implementation: Each is 3 to 6 primitive shapes with a black brush outline and dot shading; the jelly wobbles with a damped sine on sq.

new_assets.name: moonCounter
new_assets.description: A row of n small moon icons (r 22, spacing 62) in panel space at y 110 that light or go dark one by one; used for the eight nights (S9-S14).
new_assets.implementation: Loop of n discs: lit = yellow with two crater dots, dark = outline only; each change pops with settleTo(); driven by a list of tick times.

owner_questions: The Kaaba is drawn as a simple black cube with a plain gold band, no writing, with faceless white background pilgrims and no comic lettering near it; default: keep this respectful, simplified picture (alternative: show only the arcade and never the Kaaba itself).

"He spent the night with her" is staged as the two talking and laughing at a table, seated apart, while the window sky turns from dusk to dawn; default: nothing more intimate is shown anywhere in the film.
The bath happens entirely behind a folding screen with only his foamy head visible; default: keep the screen.
The husband's betrayal is shown inside a thought cloud as him offering a rose to a maid under a small heart that then cracks; default: this symbol only.
The revenge "with the filthiest man in Baghdad" is shown as a search ring choosing the ragged sweep, with the invented tag FILTHIEST!; default: keep the tag (the subtitles carry the exact words).
The slaughterhouse refuse is drawn as brown scraps and white bones with smell lines and flies, no blood or carcasses; default: keep it bloodless.
The punishment is softened to a guard's hand on the shoulder and a cane held upright in a thought cloud; no blow is shown; default: keep.
Additions beyond the script for comedy: the emir and pilgrims laugh at the end, and after his release the sweep starts praying again (in the THE END hold); default: keep both.

Invented lettering: PILGRIMAGE SEASON, BAGHDAD, HEY!, HIM!, THE BATH, OUCH!, NIGHT 1, 8 NIGHTS, HIDE!, SORRY x3, FILTHIEST!, HA HA HA!, and the cards HIS STORY... and THE EIGHTH NIGHT...; default: keep all.
Given the adult theme (an affair and revenge) even in this discreet staging, should this film be published for the general family audience; default: yes, with the staging above.
The pilgrims and the sweep at the Kaaba wear a simplified plain white robe rather than accurate two-piece ihram; default: simplified robe.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; world sizes: kaabaCourt 1900 x 1230, marketStreet 2000 x 1230, palaceHall 1000 x 1230; ground y 900 in all three. Clamp the camera to each world (template camAt).
All cue times are word starts from planning/inputs/timeline.md; use w(p, n) lookups, not literals, so a narration change re-times the film.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so every person and the donkey blink; add explicit blinks where lid is set by hand.

One sweep function sweepP(t, look) with look = rags | clean | pilgrim choosing the costume; the prayer pose and its thought-cloud inside function are written once and reused at 3.6, 163.1 and 172.2 (setup and payoff). The lady's pointing pose object is shared by 47.3 and 145.8.
Peeks (alley S5, lattice S11-S12): draw the actor, then the occluder; eyes on the dark use eye2 directly. Never a clipped second copy.
Thought clouds: Library thoughtCloud with inside(c, t) callbacks; keep cloud figures at least 110 px tall on screen (scale 0.4-0.5) and keep clouds above y 520 so no face is covered.
Night and day: skyCycle(ctx, u) in the hall window and the gate window; tint the hall with dayCycle(u).night. S9 u: 0.45 at 81.3, 0.75 at 82.9, hold, 1.0 at 86.0.
Carry in S2: carriers use walk() on one shared x(t); the sweep is positioned from their mean x, y raised 30, his legs on a free ph = t * 14.

Journey in S15: the sweep stays at screen centre; three baked plates (street, dunes with hillTrees replaced by two dune arcs, court) slide by one offset function D(t); walk() takes D so the legs match the ground; the costume and set swap on the frame when the foreground palm trunk (120 wide) covers him.

Sound: effects only in the four pauses (11.90-13.00, 23.18-23.86, 29.28-30.00, 39.82-41.18) and after 171.96; SND master 0.6; the narration is otherwise continuous, so all other beats are silent picture gags.
Shake only inside the picture panel (template pattern); call the style finish last every frame; lettering sizes: headlines at least 44 px, labels at least 28 px at 1280 x 720 scale.
Subtitles: build chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt from the subtitles array in creative_plan.json and verify by program against story/script.json.
warnings: Adult theme: the plan relies on symbols (table talk, window sky, rose, cracked heart). Do not add beds, embraces, kisses or undress anywhere; the two leads never touch except the purse hand-over.
Religious setting: keep the Kaaba plain and dignified; the comedy sits on the people, never on the building; no lettering overlaps it.

Four planned-but-unbuilt assets are needed (donkey, marketStreet, palaceHall, guard preset) plus about five new small ones; if other films have built them first, reuse those functions and only add the options listed.
The narration has only four pauses, so the film is almost silent of effects; visual rhythm must carry the gags.
S10 and S13 are dense (15 s each with many pictograms); if phone legibility suffers, drop the tidy-servant rejection in S13 and the third gift pass in S10 first.
The person figure is front facing only: carrying, kneeling to the side and hand-overs must be staged with world hand targets and facing by dir; check stills for arm IK limits (arms about 74 units).
